description: Create a reply DRAFT for an Email Assistant conversation. Never sends. The draft is saved in the farm's Email Assistant (it pre-fills the reply box in QuailOS for that thread) and returns a draftId usable with send_email. Recipient defaults to the other party of the conversation and must be a participant of that thread. Owner/admin read/write AI keys only.

emailId.description: The message being replied to (from list_emails/get_email)

idempotencyKey.description: Optional unique client key; repeating it returns the same draft

showInApp.description: Pre-fill the QuailOS reply box for this thread with the draft (default true; replaces any auto Magic Draft suggestion shown there)

to.description: Optional recipient address; must already be a participant of this conversation (default: the original sender)

name: draft_email_reply
